description: My School is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Curriculum, Assessment and Reporting Authority (ACARA). My School provides information that helps parents and the community in understanding the performance of schools over time. My School contains data on every school in Australia, searchable by school name, suburb, state, school sector (government or non-government), and school type (primary, secondary, combined, or special). Data includes information on a school’s student profile, NAPLAN performance, funding, enrolment numbers, attendance rates, and staff numbers. Coverage is Australia, 2014 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-21. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
